templates.name: Spamhaus DROP
templates.description: Netblocks hijacked by criminal organizations (botnets, malware distribution). The classic baseline for inbound AND outbound blocking.

templates.name: FireHOL Level 3
templates.description: Aggressive community list: hosts involved in brute-force attacks, spyware or viruses within the last 30 days. Updated daily.

templates.name: Emerging Threats Block IPs
templates.description: Community-curated CIDR blocklist (includes Spamhaus DROP). A good general-purpose baseline for home and office networks.

templates.name: Emerging Threats Compromised IPs
templates.description: Individual IPv4 addresses of known compromised or malicious hosts (one per line). More targeted than the full blocklist.

templates.name: BlockList.de SSH
templates.description: IPs observed attempting SSH brute-force attacks. Useful when you run SSH on this network; refreshes frequently.
